name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-07-13, at wavelengths from 1.18 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
